facts: Public db sync calls sendSync and promise calls invoke dedicated db channels; not plugin.api dispatcher.
Clipboard public surface has V1 history/write/config/onChange, without production V2 negotiation/feed/plan/result API.
Dispatcher selects registered handler and calls it; this layer has no sender/grant/policy checks.
Dedicated public db channels bypass this dispatcher.
Public db handlers route to lmdbInstance and return document/array values without typed read envelope.
Internal dbGet is distinct and catches failures to null; public read failure semantics require tracing router and SyncApi.

facts: LmdbDatabase sync get/allDocs delegate directly to SyncApi.
Its own PromiseApi exists but is not the public StorageRouter.promises chain.
get catches storage/cleanup exceptions and returns null.
allDocs catches exceptions and returns []; array get mode can omit failed/null rows and return others.
Wraps SyncApi calls and resolves their values; only exceptions escaping SyncApi reject.
Not on public StorageRouter.promises read path.
Exports storageManager.getRouter(); source comment explicitly identifies StorageRouter.

facts: get/allDocs select LmdbDatabase and do not catch or rewrite errors.
Public promises wrap router synchronous get/allDocs with async functions, bypassing LmdbDatabase.PromiseApi.
Null/empty-array values already folded by SyncApi resolve; exceptions escaping routing reject async reads. Uncaught sync IPC behavior is not runtime-verified.

publicReadChain: StorageRouter get/allDocs, with promises implemented as async wrappers of these same synchronous methods

conclusions.remainingThrowBoundary: Routing/selection/IPC errors outside SyncApi catch are not proven folded. Router async wrappers reject escaping exceptions; synchronous IPC uncaught behavior was not executed.
